description: Road Reserves is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. In the ACT the Road Reserve is an area between blocks set aside for the movement of the public using various modes of transport, for the delivery of utilities and similar public purposes. All Road Reservers are traced from cadastral boundaries. Coverage: ACT Government Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
